mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods WHERE gb_distributer_purchase_goods_id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id

SELECT CAST(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0) AS CHAR) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
AND gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price) != ''

SELECT CAST(IFNULL(MIN(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0) AS CHAR) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id
AND gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price) != ''

SELECT CAST(IFNULL(MAX(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_price AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0) AS CHAR) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id

SELECT CAST(IFNULL(SUM(CAST(gdpg.gb_DPG_buy_quantity AS DECIMAL(18,4))), 0) AS CHAR) FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods AS gdpg LEFT JOIN gb_distributer_purchase_batch AS gdpb ON gdpb.gb_distributer_purchase_batch_id = gdpg.gb_DPG_batch_id

SELECT ROUND(SUM(total_subtotal), 1) AS top10Subtotal FROM ( SELECT gb_DPG_dis_goods_id, ROUND(SUM(gb_DPG_buy_subtotal), 1) AS total_subtotal FROM gb_distributer_purchase_goods WHERE gb_DPG_stock_finish_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{stopDate} AND gb_DPG_distributer_id = #{disId} AND gb_DPG_status > 2 AND gb_DPG_buy_subtotal > 0 GROUP BY gb_DPG_dis_goods_id ORDER BY total_subtotal DESC LIMIT 10 ) t
